# SOSColombia

> Independent, volunteer-run tracker of verified data on the August 10, 2026 earthquake in Colombia. Not a government or news outlet. Spanish-first (English at /en).

## About

SOSColombia is an independent project, not affiliated with the Colombian government, UNGRD, or any news outlet. It aggregates and cross-checks figures from official bulletins (UNGRD, INMLCF/Medicina Legal, SGC, DANE), international humanitarian reports (OCHA, UNICEF, Cruz Roja Colombiana), local governments (Cali, Armenia, Manizales, Cauca), and press/social sources, then republishes them with full attribution.

The core discipline: every figure carries its source, a source-quality tier (1 = official primary source, down to 6), and the date it claims to represent (`asOf`), separate from when it was captured (`retrievedAt`). Figures are append-only — a new report never overwrites an old one, so the full history of how a number changed over time stays visible. When two credible sources disagree, the site logs both and states the disagreement openly (see /metodologia) instead of picking one as "the" number.

## What This Site Tracks

- **Cities/municipios**: 11 tracked in depth — Pereira, Dosquebradas (Risaralda); Cali, Buenaventura (Valle del Cauca); Manizales (Caldas); Armenia, Pijao (Quindío); Quibdó, San José del Palmar (Chocó); Popayán (Cauca); Ibagué (Tolima) — 7 departments. A national UNGRD situation report cites a broader 14 departments / 403 municipios affected overall.
- **Death toll**: tracked as multiple parallel metrics from different institutions, never merged into a single number — officially reported deaths (UNGRD, OCHA) and forensically confirmed deaths (INMLCF/Medicina Legal, bodies received vs. bodies identified), plus injured, missing (official vs. crowdsourced), and people/families affected ("damnificados").
- **Structural damage**: homes destroyed/damaged, collapsed buildings, affected schools/health centers/community centers.
- **Aid points**: shelters (albergues), collection points (acopios), health points, veterinary/animal-welfare points, blood donation points, and monetary donation points — each with a status (active/full/closed/unconfirmed) and a source.
- **Crowdfunding campaigns**: GoFundMe, Vaki, and organizational funds (UNICEF, Cruz Roja Colombiana, World Vision, CARE, Save the Children, Fundación Éxito, Fundación Bancolombia, Confecámaras/ABACO, and others), each with a verification status (verified / plausible / unconfirmed / flagged as scam) and whether it's reachable from outside Colombia.
- **Government reports**: official documents and bulletins (presidential decree, departmental disaster declarations, UNGRD balances, OCHA flash updates, INMLCF comunicados).
- **Source registry**: every source used, with its org, tier, live/dead status, and how many records trace back to it.
- **Open contradictions**: logged explicitly rather than silently resolved, each with both conflicting values and both sources.

## Structure

- `/` — home page, cities overview with severity and latest death-toll figure per city
- `/cifras` — national and department-level figures over time, plus full append-only history per metric
- `/mapa` — interactive map of tracked cities and the earthquake epicenter (SGC and USGS readings shown separately)
- `/ayuda` — aid points directory, filterable by type
- `/donar` — donation info: verified campaigns, local monetary-donation points, scam warnings
- `/donar/internacional` — donation channels reachable from outside Colombia
- `/informes` — official government reports and bulletins
- `/fuentes` — full source registry (organization, tier, status, records derived)
- `/metodologia` — open and resolved data contradictions, and how the project handles conflicting figures
- `/ciudad/{divipola-code}` — per-city dashboard: figures, aid points, and crowdfunding campaigns for that municipio (e.g. `/ciudad/76001` for Cali)
- `/sugerir` — form to suggest an aid point (goes to moderation, not published directly)
- `/comunidad` — verified social-media posts (aid requests, official updates) by city
- `/recursos` — links to other independent trackers, directories, and donation platforms built by other people for this event
- `/historias` — long-form editorial pieces expanding on specific crowdfunding campaigns and community posts, each explicitly linked back to the real campaign/post/city it's based on; admin-authored, bilingual (es/en) at the database level, not machine-translated
- `/datos` — open data export: full dataset as JSON, plus CSV for toll records and aid points
- `/cambios` — public activity feed: every new figure, verified aid point, reviewed campaign, logged discrepancy, and added resource, most recent first

English versions of every page exist at the same path prefixed with `/en` (e.g. `/en/mapa`, `/en/ciudad/76001`). Spanish is the default, unprefixed locale.

## Data Export

The full dataset is machine-readable at `/api/export` (JSON: event, toll records, aid points, crowdfunding campaigns, gov reports, contradictions, allied resources — each with its source). Two CSV mirrors cover single tables: `/api/export/csv/toll-records`, `/api/export/csv/aid-points`. Moderation-queue submissions are never included. Free to reuse with attribution; see `/metodologia`.

## Markdown Mirrors

Clean, AI-readable markdown versions of every content page are served at `/md/{page-path}` (plain text, `Content-Type: text/markdown`, no HTML/CSS/JS): `/md`, `/md/ayuda`, `/md/cambios`, `/md/cifras`, `/md/ciudad/{divipola-code}`, `/md/comunidad`, `/md/datos`, `/md/donar`, `/md/donar/internacional`, `/md/fuentes`, `/md/historias`, `/md/historias/{slug}`, `/md/informes`, `/md/mapa`, `/md/metodologia`, `/md/recursos`. Spanish-only (default locale), same as the underlying pages' default content. The two submission forms (`/sugerir`, `/comunidad/sugerir`) and their thank-you pages aren't mirrored — they're interactive flows, not content to quote.

## Key Facts

- Earthquake occurred August 10, 2026, 07:34 local time (UTC-5), Colombia.
- Magnitude 7.4, reported consistently by both the Servicio Geológico Colombiano (SGC) and USGS.
- Epicenter near San José del Palmar, Chocó — SGC reads 4.99, -76.29; USGS reads 4.8436, -76.2422 (the two agencies' readings differ slightly and both are shown).
- Depth: SGC ~103 km (revised upward across several bulletins), USGS ~110.3 km — logged as an open, unresolved discrepancy.
- 11 municipios are tracked in depth (across 7 departments); a national UNGRD report separately cites 403 municipios and 14 departments affected overall.
- Reported death toll moved from 239 (UNGRD, Aug 12) to 241 (OCHA Flash Update 004, Aug 12) to 265 (UNGRD, Aug 13); forensic confirmation (INMLCF) separately logged 230 bodies received / 205 identified as of Aug 12 — these are different metrics, not corrections of each other.
- Presidential Decreto 1171 declared a national state of disaster the night of August 11, 2026.
- San José del Palmar, the literal epicenter, had zero confirmed deaths as of the last recorded figure.

## Contact / Contributing

Anyone can suggest an aid point at `/sugerir` — submissions go into a moderation queue and are reviewed before publication, never published automatically. No public contact email or phone number is listed on the site.
